item.description:
Bouncebin 1.1.4

  • Choosing folders is a list now, not a box of paths to edit by hand. Each folder shows its name and where it is, with a Remove button on the row, and a folder that has gone missing says so on itself.
  • Settings says what actually happens to what it finds — copied into Bouncebin's own library so iCloud cannot clear it out, big lossless files converted on the way in to save room, and where those copies land.
  • A fresh install starts at ~/Music rather than at folders that only existed on one Mac. The Apple Music library and your DAW's own sample storage are skipped, so a first scan finds your bounces and not everything you have ever listened to.
